Commercial Roofing and Coatings

Roofing, repairs, inspections and coatings for businesses, industrial units, retail premises, schools, offices and warehouses across Lancashire and the Fylde coast.

How We Do Commercial Roofing

We work on businesses, industrial units, retail premises, schools, offices and warehouses: flat roof systems, repairs, leak detection, roof inspections and planned maintenance. Roof coatings restore and protect an existing roof without the cost of a full replacement.

What We Work On

Factories, workshops, warehouses, distribution centres, offices, retail units and shopping centres, as well as schools and property management companies. A business has to keep running while the roof is done, so we plan the work for as little disruption as we can manage.

Leak Detection and Inspections

We find where a leak is coming from before recommending a repair. An inspection shows the condition of the roof, picks up problems early and helps you plan future maintenance.

Maintenance Contracts

Scheduled inspections, preventative maintenance and priority repairs, on a flexible contract for commercial and industrial properties.

Roof Coatings

A coating creates a seamless waterproof barrier over an existing roof, and can restore an ageing flat roof. Reflective coatings cut heat absorption and protect the materials from UV. Not every roof can be coated, so we inspect it first and tell you if something else makes more sense.

Signs a Commercial Roof Needs Work

  • Leaks showing inside the building after rain
  • Cracked or blistered coatings
  • Standing water that doesn't clear
  • Lifting seams or corroded sheets
